tei:div.tei:p: skabs bzhi pa rnam rdzogs sbyor ba/

gnyis pa thabs sbyor bzhi la bzhi ste/ mkhyen gsum gyi rnam pa bsdus nas sgom pa rnam rdzogs sbyor ba/ de rab tu gyur pa rtse mo'i sbyor ba/ de go rim du sgom pa mthar gyis pa'i sbyor ba/ de cig car du sgom pa skad cig ma'i sbyor ba'o/ /dang po (rnam rdzogs sbyor ba )la gnyis te/ 'brel bkod pa/ mngon rtogs rgyas par bshad pa'o// dang po ni/ gzhi shes mtshon byed kyi chos dgu bstan zin pa'i rjes nas/ sbyor ba bzhi 'chad de/ skabs dang po gsum du mkhyen gsum mtshan nyid kyi sgo nas shes par bya ba'i ched du de dag gi rgyu dang*/ yul dang ngo bo dang spang gnyen sogs kyi mtshon nas gtso bor bstan la/ mthong sgom sogs kyi lam gyi rnam pa gsungs pa 'ga' zhig yod kyang phyogs re bar zad pas/ de'i phyir 'di dag gi skabs su mi mthun phyogs mtshan 'dzin 'joms pa dang skye med gsum rtogs pa'i ched du mkhyen gsum gyi rnam pa ma lus par gnyen po'i tshul du sgom pa bstan zhing*/ de yang sgra yangs par byas na/ rnam rdzogs sbyor ba zhes pa sbyor ba bzhi ga la 'jug ste rnam pa brgya don gsum nyid sgom par mtshungs pa'i phyir/ de'i sbyor ba dang po gsum ni spang bya gcig la ltos na spel mar skye ste rnam kun tshogs lam du sgom pa ni/ mthong spangs rnam par sun 'byin pa'i gnyen po/ sbyor lam rtse sbyor de spong ba gnyen po'i cha shas dang*/ de sngon du song ba'i rjes thob tu sgom pa mthar gyis pa ni thag sring ba'i gnyen por 'gyur zhing/ gzhi'i gnyen po rnam grol lam ni 'dir ma bstan no/ /de dag las thog mar mkhyen gsum thos bsam gyi rtogs pa la/ dbang thob phyir du sgom pa rnam rdzogs sbyor ba bstan te/ rab sbyor gyis yum ma mchis pa'i phar phyin du bstan pa sogs kyi don no// bsgom bya rnam pa/ gnyis pa (mngon rtogs rgyas par bshad pa )la gnyis te/

sbyor ba spyi'i rnam gzhag /rnam rdzogs sbyor ba nyid bstan pa'o/ /dang po( sbyor ba spyi'i rnam gzhag )la bzhi ste/ bsgom bya rnam pa/ sgom mkhan gang zag /sbyor ba'i ngo bo/ sbyor ba'i sngon 'gro'o/ /dang po (bsgom bya rnam pa )la gnyis te/ mdor bstan pa dang*/ rgyas par bshad pa'o/ /dang po (mdor bstan pa )la gnyis te/ spyi'i don dang*/ gzhung don no// dang po ni/ 'di skabs kyi rnam pa ni dmigs rnam gnyis kyis phye ba'i rnam pa ste/ dmigs pa ni skye 'gag gnas gsum dang bral ba'i sher phyin yin kyang sgom tshul gyi dbang gis skye med gsum zhes brjod pa de'o/ /rnam pa la shes pa phyi don gyi rnam par shar ba lta bu kun rdzob pa'i rnam pa dang*/ phyi don 'khrul pa'i skye 'gag sogs kyi rnam par mi 'char bar rang gi ngo bo rang gis rig pa/ 'od gsal ba'i tshul du 'char ba don gyi rnam pa gnyis las 'dir phyi ma ste/ dmigs rnam gnyis don la ngo bo gcig kyang glo bur gyi dri ma bral rim gyis rang 'od je gsal du gyur pa'i cha nas rnam par bshad pa'o/ /de'i phyir mos spyod du bsgom bya'i mkhyen gsum gyi rnam pa dang slob lam du bsgom bya'i rnam mkhyen gyi rnam pa rnams ni/ rnam pa dngos min gyi rigs 'dra tsam yin la sgom pa sbyor ba ni rnam pa thams cad du mtshan nyid pa'o/ /'dir gzhi shes kyi rnam pa sgom pas gang zag med par sgom pa'i theg chen sgom lam srid do snyam na/ de ni mi rtag sogs su blta ba'i mtshan ma yin pas byang sems kyi ched du mi sgom yang gzhi skye med du sgom pas de yar ldan du 'dus te/ chos bdag med par rtogs na gang zag med par rtogs pa don gyi gsal ba ltar ro// gnyis pa gzhung don ni/ gzhi shes pa yi bye brag rnams// rnam pa zhes bya mtshan nyid de// kun mkhyen nyid ni rnam gsum phyir// de ni rnam pa gsum du 'dod// shes bya'i gzhi skye med gsum dngos dang rjes mthun par shes pa'i blo gros kyi bye brag so sor skyes pa rnams ni rnam pa zhes bya ba'i mtshan nyid de/

spyir dbye na/ kun mkhyen nyid ni rnam gsum phyir/ /de ni rnam pa gsum du 'dod/ /ces gsungs so// gnyis pa rgyas bshad la gsum ste/ gzhi shes kyi rnam pa nyer bdun/ lam shes kyi rnam pa so drug /rnam mkhyen gyi rnam pa brgya dang bcu bshad pa'o//dang po ni/ med pa'i rnam pa nas bzung ste// mi g.yo ba yi rnam pa'i bar// bden pa so so la bzhi dang*// lam la de ni bco lngar bshad// de dag so sor dbye na/ med pa'i rnam pa nas bzung ste mi g.yo ba'i rnam pa'i bar/ bden pa dang po gsum po so so la dmigs pa'i rnam pa bzhi bzhi dang lam bden de la dmigs pa'i rnam pa de ni bco lngar bshad do/ /mdo ni/ rab 'byor nam mkha' med pa'i phyir yum ni med pa'i phar phyin no/ /zhes sogs so/ /de las sdug bden la dmigs pa'i rnam pa bzhi ni/ rtag dngos su med pa dang*/ chos rnams mi skye ba dang*/ bdag gis dben pa dang*/ mi dmigs pas mi brdzi ba'o// kun bden gyi bzhi ni/ bskyed pa'i gzhi min pas gnas med pa dang*/ nyon mongs skye 'gag med pas nam mkha' dang*/ rtog dpyod bral bas sgras brjod du med pa dang*/ ming bzhi'i phung po med pa'o// 'gog bden gyi bzhi ni/ gang du'ang 'gro ba med cing song nas thob bya min pa dang gzod nas zhi bas gsar du mi 'phrog pa dang*/ chos nyid yin pas mi zad pa dang*/ gzod nas ma grub pas skye ba med pa'o/ /de dag ni mngon pa nas 'byung ba'i mi rtag pa sogs kyi mtshan nyid do// lam bden gyi rnam pa bco lnga las/ nyon mongs kyi gnyen po zag med lam la dmigs pa'i rnam pa bzhi ni/ 'bras bu thob par byed pa po med pa dang*/ bdag med pas shes pa po med pa dang*/ 'dor len gyi 'pho ba med pa dang*/ rang bzhin gyis stong pas spang bya 'dul ba med pa'o/ /de dag ni lam sogs bzhi'i mtshan nyid dag go /de rnams kyis slob ma'i lam dang mthun par bden bzhi la dmigs shing blo'i rnam pa ni de las lhag par gyur pa bstan nas rang rgyal dang mthun par gzung rtog gi gnyen po lam la dmigs pa la gnyis las/

rjes thob kyi tshe dmigs pa'i rnam pa lnga ni/ gzung ba ngo bo nyid med pa rmi lam dang*/ bden pa'i rgyu las ma skyes pa sgra brnyan brag cha dang*/ rnam pa tsam ma 'gags pa mig yor grib ma dang*/ gzod nas zhi ba smig rgyu dang*/ rang bzhin gyis rnam par dag pa sgyu ma lta bu'i rnam pa'o// zag med mnyam gzhag gi tshe dmigs pa'i rnam pa drug ni/ dor bya kun nas nyon mongs pa med pa dang*/ blang bya rnam par byang ba'i dngos po med pa dang*/ de'i bag chags kyis gos pa'i gzhi med pas 'od gsal ba dang*/ gzugs la sogs pa'i dbye ba'i spros pa med pa dang*/ de'i phyir rtog pa'i rlom pa med pa dang*/ mi stong bar 'dzin pa'i yongs su nyams pa med pas mi g.yo ba'i rnam pa'o// 'di dag kyang byang sems rang rgyal las blo'i rnam pa mchog tu 'gyur te/ de yang rtog pa la lhan skyes dang kun brtags kyi cha gnyis/ dang po la gzung 'dzin gnyis su zhen pa'i sgra don 'dzin pa'i rtog pa dang*/ gnyis su snang ba'i yang dag min rtog gnyis ni rim pas dag pa gnyis la'ang sgrib byed de theg chen mthong sgom gyi spang byar gyur pa'o/ /phyi ma 'di la dngos dang de'i bag chags gnas ngan len gyi ming can/ ji lta ba dang ji snyed pa mthong ba'i sgrib byed kyi dbye bas chags thogs gnyis yod pa ni rgyun mtha'i mnyam rjes kyi ye shes gnyis kyi rim pas spong ngo*/ /rang rgyal gyis ni de dag spong mi nus kyi gzung ba kun brtags gzung 'dzin rdzas gzhan du zhen pa tsam spong ba ste/ don snang phy-i don nyid du zhen pa sgom lam rjes thob tu dang*/ snang ba de shes pa'i ngo bor zhen pa mnyam gzhag tu spong bas so// gnyis pa lam shes kyi rnam pa so drug bshad pa ni/ rgyu dang lam dang sdug bsngal dang*// 'gog pa la ni go rim bzhin// de dag brgyad dang bdun dang ni// lnga dang bcu drug ces bsgrags so// rgyu kun 'byung dang*/

lam dang*/ sdug bsngal dang*/ 'gog pa'i bden pa la ni dmigs nas go rim bzhin du de dag rtogs pa'i rnam pa brgyad dang bdun dang ni/ lnga dang bcu drug ces bsgrags so/ /mdo ni/ 'dod chags dmigs su med pa'i phyir/ zhes sogs so// de las kun bden la dmigs pa'i rnam pa brgyad ni/ yul la 'dun pa dang zhen pa'i 'dod chags dang yang srid la dga' ba ste/ rgyu'i rnam pa gsum gyi gnyen por 'dod chags dang bral ba dang*/ 'dun pa med pas mi gnas pa dang*/ mtshan ma zhi ba'i rnam pa gsum mo/ /dug gsum ste/ kun 'byung gi gsum gyi gnyen por dug gsum med pa gsum mo/ /gnyis su snang ba'i kun 'byung ste/ rab skye'i gcig gi gnyen por nyon mongs kyi rgyu gnyis 'dzin zhi ba gcig go /sems can du zhen pa 'jig tshogs la lta ba rkyen gyi gcig gi gnyen por sems can med pa gcig go/ lam gyi bdun ni/ tshad med pa dang mtha' gnyis dang ma 'brel ba ni/ sems can thams cad byang chub tu bgrod pa'i go skabs 'byed pa'i lam yin te shes rab dang snying rjes mtha' gnyis dang ma 'brel bar 'byed pa'i phyir/ tha mi dad pa dang mchog tu 'dzin pa med pa ni/ chos thams cad tha mi dad par rtogs pa'i rigs pa yin te nyan rang gi lam la mchog 'dzin med pa'i phyir/ rnam par mi rtog pa dang gzhal du med pa ni/ bdag gnyis su mi rtog pa'i sgrub pa yin te chos nyid ni blos gzhal du med pa'i phyir/ chags pa med pa ni/ rigs pa chos rnams ni mkha' 'dra bar rtogs pa yin no/ /'di la 'thad pa ma bkod pa'o// sdug bden gyi lnga ni/ rang gi mtshan nyid mi rtag pa dang sdug bsngal ba dang stong pa dang bdag med pa bzhi/ spyi'i mtshan nyid de dag gang du yang mi lta ba gcig go/ 'gog bden gyi bcu drug ni/ nang dang*/ phyi dang*/ gnyis ka stong nyid du rtogs pa gsum ni 'gog pa dang*/ stong pa nyid dang*/ chen po dang*/ don dam dang*/

'dus byas dang*/ 'dus ma byas dang*/ mtha' las 'das pa dang*/ thog ma dang*/ tha ma med pa stong pa nyid du rtogs pa brgyad ni zhi ba dang*/ rang bzhin stong nyid du rtogs pa gcig ni gya nom dang*/ chos thams cad dang*/ rang gi mtshan nyid dang*/ mi dmigs pa stong nyid du rtogs pa gsum ni ji ltar nges par 'byung ba dang*/ dngos po med pa'i ngo bo nyid stong nyid du rtogs pa gcig ni nges par 'byung ba yin te/ de dang der zhen pa bral nas stong nyid du rtogs pa'i ye shes kyi rnam pa yin pa'i phyir/ 'di dag ni 'dzin rtog gi gnyen pa'o// gsum pa rnam mkhyen gyi rnam pa brgya dang bcu bshad pa ni/ dran pa nyer gzhag nas bzung ste// sangs rgyas rnam pa'i mthar thug rnams// lam gyi bden pa'i rjes mthun par// gang zag 'phags lam pa'i rgyud kyi bden don rtogs pa'i rnam pa gzhi shes dang lam shes kyi rnam pa dngos dang rnam mkhyen gyi rnam pa rjes mthun pa bstan te/ de yang rnam pa thams cad skye med du shes pa'i khog tu gzhi lam skye med du shes pa yang 'dus pa'i dbang gis/ kun mkhyen gsum du phye bas na// slob ma byang chub sems dpa' dang*// sangs rgyas rnams la rim bzhin te// sum cu bdun dang sum cu bzhi// sum cu rtsa dgu dag tu bzhed// mdo ni/ lus dang tshor ba dang sems dang chos mi dmigs pa'i phyir/ zhes sogs so/ /'o na gong du gzhi lam gyi rnam pa bshad pa dang mi zlos sam snyam na/ skyon med de/ gong du byang sems rang rgyud kyi dbang du byas/ 'dir sangs rgyas kyi thugs la mnga' ba'i sgo nas bzhag pa'am yang na/ gong du bden bzhi'i gnas tshul dang sbyar ba mtshan nyid kyi sgo nas dang*/ 'dir lam sgrub pa'i sgo nas bzhag pas so// de la gzhi shes dang thun mong ba'i rnam pa so bdun/ lam shes dang thun mong ba'i rnam pa so bzhi/ rnam mkhyen thun mong ma yin pa'i rnam pa so dgu bshad pa'o// dang po (gzhi shes dang thun mong ba'i rnam pa so bdun )la bdun te/

dngos po rtogs pa'i lam/ rtsol byung gi lam/ ting 'dzin yongs sbyong gi lam/ mngon rtogs la sbyor ba'i lam/ mngon rtogs dang 'brel ba'i lam/ bden pa mngon rtogs kyi lam/ rnam dag nges 'byin gyi lam mo// dang po (dngos po rtogs pa'i lam )ni/ bdag 'dzin gyi rten lus/ bdag gi longs spyod du 'dzin pa'i rten tshor ba/ bdag gi dngos por rtogs pa'i rten sems/ bdag kun nyon dang rnam byang du rtogs pa'i rten sems byung dad sogs dang chags sogs kyi chos la shes rab kyi rim pas mi gtsang ba/ sdug bsngal ba/ mi rtag pa/ bdag med pa'i dran pa nye bar 'jog pa'o/ /de yang nang phyi gnyis ka'i lus dbang po yul dbang rten lnga lnga po rnams la dur khrod kyi lus ltar rang mtshan mi gtsang ba spyi mtshan rang bzhin med par sgom/ de ltar lus gsum po la brten nas/ dmigs shing skyes pa'i tshor ba sems chos rnams kyang lus kyi dbye bas gsum gsum du 'gyur zhing*/ sgom tshul yang sngar gyis 'gre'o// gnyis pa (rtsol byung gi lam )ni/ de bsgoms pas mi dge skyes pa spong ba/ ma skyes pa mi bskyed pa/ dge ba skyes pa spel ba/ ma skyes pa bskyed pa'i phyir brtson 'grus rtsom mo/ /de re rer yang dang por byed 'dod pa'i 'dun pa de las zhi lhag la 'bad pa de la zhum rgod kyi gnyen por brtson 'grus rtsom ji ltar na shes rab kyis sems sdud cing*/ zhi gnas kyis de'i steng du sems 'jog pas sgom mo/ /'di'i dge mi dge ni/ yum nas 'byung ba'i yid la byed mi byed do// gsum pa (ting 'dzin yongs sbyong gi lam )ni/ de bsgoms pas gus sbyor gyi 'dun par brten pa'i ting nge 'dzin/ rtag sbyor gyi brtson 'grus la brten pa'i ting nge 'dzin/ sngon ting nge 'dzin thob pa'i sems la brten pa'i ting nge 'dzin/ chos rnams shes rab kyis dpyod pa la brten pa'i ting nge 'dzin sems rtse gcig pa skye zhing de skyes pa na rdzu 'phrul yang thob bo/

/de ni nyes pa le lo/ /gdam ngag brjed pa/ bying rgod de zhi bas sems 'du mi byed pa ma zhi bas sems 'phro ba'i 'du byed pa lnga'i le lo'i gnyen por 'dun pa brtson 'grus dad pa shin sbyangs kyi ting nge 'dzin bzhi sgom/ lhag ma bzhi'i gnyen por dran pa shes bzhin 'du byed pa sems rnal du 'jog pa'i btang snyoms bzhi ste spong ba'i 'du byed brgyad sgom pa'o/ /de gsum tshogs lam chung 'bring che gsum nas gtso bor sgom pa'o// bzhi pa (mngon rtogs la sbyor ba'i lam )ni/ de bsgoms pas byang chub la yid ches pa'i dad pa/ byang sems kyi spyod pa la sbyor ba'i brtson 'grus/ dmigs pa mi brjed pa'i dran pa/ sems mi 'phro ba'i ting nge 'dzin/ chos rnam par 'byed pa'i shes rab ste rang rang gi snga ma snga ma la dbang byed pa'o/ /de yang bden pa la yid ches des na de rtogs pa la spro rtogs nas mi brjed ma brjed pa la rtse gcig gnas/ de'i don rnam par nges pa'i tshul gyis sgom mo// lnga pa (mngon rtogs dang 'brel ba'i lam )ni/ de bsgoms pas/ mi mthun phyogs ma dad pa/ le lo/ brjed ngas/ rnam g.yeng*/ gti mug rnams 'joms pa ste dbang po lnga mthu cher gyur pa'o/ sgom tshul sngar bzhin no/ de gnyis ni drod rtse dang bzod mchog nas sgom pa'o//

drug pa (bden pa mngon rtogs kyi lam )ni/ de bsgoms pas/ gnas tshul mi brjed pa'i dran pa/ rnam rtog 'joms pa'i shes rab chos rab tu rnam 'byed/ mngon shes myur du sgrub pa'i brtson 'grus*/ chos kyi snang ba 'phel bas lus sems tshim pa'i dga' ba/ lus sems las rung gi bde ba thob pa shin tu sbyangs pa/ ye shes kyi 'byor pa skye ba'i rtse gcig pa'i ting nge 'dzin/ rnam par mi rtog pa'i ye shes btang snyoms yang dag rnams ni byang chub kyi gnas sogs yan lag tu 'gyur te/ dran pa ni byang chub kyi gnas/ chos rnam 'byed ni ngo bo/ brtson 'grus ni nges 'byung/ dga' ba ni phan yon/ lhag ma rnams nyon mongs med pa'i yan lag go /de dag re rer yang bden bzhir dmigs nas shes bya spang bya mngon du bya ba rgyud la bsten byar sgom zhing mthong lam nas yod do// bdun pa (rnam dag nges 'byin gyi lam )ni/ de bsgoms pas/ gnas tshul ji lta bar rtogs pa'i yang dag pa'i lta ba/ de'i mthus mdo sde sogs kyi don rtogs pa'i rtog pa/ ngag gi las dag pa'i ngag lus kyi las dag pa'i las kyi mtha'/ /ngag gi kha gsags dang lus kyi bcos ma sogs dag pa'i 'tsho ba/ yun ring por shes sgrib spong ba la mi skyo ba'i rtsol ba/ bying rgod kyi gnyen por dran pa/ mngon shes sogs la sgrib pa'i snyoms 'jug gi sgrib pa'i gnyen por ting nge 'dzin rnams ni 'phags lam gyi yongs su gcod pa sogs kyi yan lag tu 'gyur te/ lta bas mthong lam gyi rtog pa yongs su gcod/ rtog pa dang ngag gis gzhan la go bar byed/ ngag las kyi mtha' 'tsho ba gsum gyis lta ba tshul khrims yo byad bskyungs pa la yid ches par byed/ lhag ma gsum gnyen po'i yan lag go /sgom tshul byang chub yan lag bzhin la sa gnyis pa nas sgom pa'o// gnyis pa lam shes dang thun mong ba'i rnam pa so bzhi bshad pa la drug ste/ gnyen po'i lam/

sprul pa'i lam/ mthong chos la bder gnas kyi lam/ 'jig rten las 'das pa'i lam/ spong ba'i lam/ sangs rgyas nyid kyi lam mo// dang po (gnyen po'i lam )ni/ yul bdag gnyis/ bdag gnyis kyi rten phung po lnga/ rten de zhi ba gsum la dmigs nas/ stong pa nyid/ smon pa med pa/ mtshan ma med pa'i ting nge 'dzin gsum mo/ /de ni 'dus byas kun mi rtag pa dang rnam rtog kun sdug bsngal bar sgom pa smon med kyi rgyu/ bdag med par sgom pa stong nyid kyi rgyu/ myang 'das rtog pa nyer zhir sgom pa mtshan med kyi rgyu'o/ /bden bzhi'i rnam pa rnams kyang 'dir 'dus te sgo dang por stong bdag med gnyis/ gnyis par mi rtag sdug bsngal kun 'byung gi rnams/ gsum par 'gog lam gyi brgyad 'dus so// gnyis pa (sprul pa'i lam )ni/ rang gi gzugs la chags pa ma bral ba'am/ bral kyang gzugs kyi 'du shes ma bshig par snod bcud kyi gzugs che chung mdzes mi mdzes sogs sna tshogs su sprul pa gzugs can gzugs la lta ba/ rang gi gzugs la 'dod chags bral ba'am/ ma bral kyang 'du shes bshig nas phyi'i gzugs la sngar ltar sprul ba gzugs med gzugs la lta ba gnyis ni/ sprul pa'i sgrib pa las rnam par thar byed kyi sgo'o/ /zangs dngul gser gyi bum pa lta bu gsum las dngul bum la dmigs nas gzhan gnyis la ltos te sdug mi sdug gnyis kar lta/ yang de gzhan gnyis dang 'brel bar lta/ de bzhin du mi sdug pa yang sdug pa dang 'brel bar lta bas chos kun la bsgre ba khyad par sdug pa ste/ sdug pa 'ba' zhig sprul 'dod kyi sgrib pa las thar ba'o// gsum pa (mthong chos la bder gnas kyi lam )ni/ gzugs med bzhi sems sems byung 'gog pa'i snyoms 'jug ste rang sa'i ro myang gi sred pa dang tshor 'du las thar ba'o/ /de'i steng du snga ma gsum bsnan na rnam thar brgyad do/ /'di dag theg chen lugs na lus rten dang por thob pa mi'i rten skyes zin gnas pa gzugs khams pa'i rten la'ang yod/

sems rten bsam gtan bzhi pa'i rab mthar bsten par mtshungs so// bzhi pa ('jig rten las 'das pa'i lam )ni/ bsam gtan bzhi/ gzugs med bzhi/ 'gog pa'i snyoms 'jug ste mthar gnas kyi snyoms 'jug dgu'o/ /dang po brgyad 'das lam gyi rten phyi ma 'das lam gyi rjes la thos pas sam phyi ma ngo bo yin pa'i dbang gis so/ /snyoms 'jug dang rnam thar gyi khyad ni bar chad med lam dang rnam grol lam yin no// lnga pa (spong ba'i lam )ni/ mthong lam bzod pa bzhi'o// drug pa (sangs rgyas nyid kyi lam )ni/ phar phyin bcu'o/ /'dir 'gog snyoms bshad na/ theg dman lugs/ theg chen lugs so/ /dang po (theg dman lugs )la gnyis te/ rten/ ngo bo'o/ /dang po ni/ lus rten sngar bzhin sems rten la 'jug pa'i rten srid rtse ste sems kyi rgyu ba 'gog sla bas so/ /ldang ba'i tshe srid rtse'i dag pa dang ci yang med gang rung gi sems la brten no//gnyis pa (ngo bo )ni/ tshor 'du rags pas sun nas lus kyi steng du sems sems byung 'gog pa ste/ dge ba dang ldan min 'du byed du 'dod cing lus mngon byed dang gnyis ka'i cha las rnam grol gyi dgra bcom gang rung gi kun slong gis ji tsam 'phangs pa'i bar du 'jug pa'o// gnyis pa (theg chen lugs )la/ thun mong ba ni tshor 'du 'gog pa tsam ste/ nyan thos dang mthun zhing de la byang sems kyi zhag bdun las lhag par mi gnas so/ /thun mong min pa la dbu sems gnyis kyi lugs/ dang po ni/ sa drug pa nas thob cing de la sa bdun par rang gi 'jug ldang nus/ sa brgyad par rjes thob tu yang mtshan 'dzin med pas de las ldang ba'i tshe sangs rgyas kyis slong dgos par bstan pa'i de bzhin nyid kyi steng du/ sher phyin gyis spros mtshan bkag pa'o/ /sems tsam lugs la dman lam sngon du ma song ba'i slob pa'i dbang du na mthong lam gyi rjes thob nas yod cing*/ kun gzhi'i rnam shes kyi steng du ye shes kyis tshogs bdun 'khor bcas 'gog pa'o/

/de rang ngo ye shes min kyang ye shes rgyun mi 'chad du yod la/ mi slob pa'i dbang du na kun gzhi'i ye shes kyi steng du glo bur gyi dri ma thams cad 'gags pa'i sangs rgyas kyi ye shes te ldang ba med pa'o/ rgyan 'dir ni dbu sems kyi lugs gnyis ka dang mthun par khas blang bar bya'o// gsum pa rnam mkhyen thun mong min pa'i rnam pa so dgu bshad pa la bdun te/ stobs bcu/ mi 'jigs pa bzhi/ so so yang dag par rig pa bzhi/chos ma 'dres pa bco brgyad/ de bzhin nyid/ rang 'byung*/ sangs rgyas kyi rnam pa'o// dang po (stobs bcu )ni/ sbyin pa las longs spyod 'byung ba gnas ser sna las de 'byung ba'i gnas ma yin pa sogs dang/ zag bcas kyi las kyi rnam smin gyi 'bras bu 'gro ba ma lus pa dang*/ sems can rnams kyi mos pa'i bye brag sna tshogs dang*/ 'jig rten gyi khams chags 'jig dang mchog dman du ma dang*/ dad pa sogs kyi dbang po rno ba mchog dang rtul 'bring mchog ma yin pa dang/ byang chub gsum po thams cad du 'gro ba'i lam dang*/ snyoms 'jug la sgrib pa'i ro myang sogs kun nas nyon mongs dang de dang bral ba'i mtshan med dang dus su ldang ba rnam par byang ba dang*/ rang gzhan gyi tshe rabs dpag tu med pa'i sngon gyi gnas rjes su dran pa dang*/ sems can kun 'chi 'pho ba dang skye ba'i tshul dang*/ sgrib gnyis kyi zag pa zad pa mkhyen pa'o/ /de las dang po ni/ bde 'gro'i thabs la bslu ba/ gnyis pa skyabs ma yin pa skyabs su bslu ba/ bdun pa zag med kyi dag pa la bslu ba lhag ma rnams theg chen gyi nges par 'byung ba la bslu ba'i bdud rnams 'joms pa'i stobs can no// gnyis pa (mi 'jigs pa bzhi )ni/ 'khor gyi dbus su nga ni sangs rgyas so/ /zhes dang*/ zag pa thams cad zad pa nyid du zhal gyis bzhes pa rang don rtogs pa dang spangs pa'i dam bca' gnyis/ sgrib gnyis kyi thar pa dang thams cad mkhyen pa'i gegs byed pa dang*/

thams cad shes pas nyan rang dang lam shes pas rdzogs pa'i byang chub tu nges par 'byung ba'i lam du zhal gyis bzhes pa gzhan don spang bya dang lam la dam bca' gnyis so/ /de dag la chos mthun gyi rgol bar rtsom pa tsam yang mi 'byung bas mi 'jigs pa'o// gsum pa (so so yang dag par rig pa bzhi )ni/ rten rgyu'i chos ming gi rnam grangs mtha' dag mkhyen pa chos dang*/ brten pa brjod bya'am 'bras bu'i chos mkhyen pa don so so yang dag par rig pa bshad bya mkhyen pa gnyis/ gcig brjod pas yul so so'i skad du go bar 'gyur ba nges pa'i tshig dang*/ rdzas yod btags yod sogs chos kyi rnam dbye mkhyen pa'i spobs pa so so yang dag par rig pa 'chad byed mkhyen pa gnyis so// bzhi pa (chos ma 'dres pa bco brgyad )ni/ glang chen gtum po dang lhan du 'chong ba sogs sku la 'khrul pa/ bzhad gad dang 'o dod sogs gsung la ca co/ bya ba mi byed pa dang dus yol sogs thugs la dran pa nyams pa/ ting nge 'dzin las bzhengs bzhugs gang la'ang thugs mnyam par ma bzhag pa/ 'khor 'das la tha dad pa'i 'du shes/ so sor ma brtags par gdul bya yal bar 'dor ba'i btang snyoms rnams mi mnga' ba ni spyod pa ma 'dres pa drug chos ston pa'i 'dun pa/ gdul bya'i bya ba sgrub pa'i brtson 'grus/ bsam mi dgos par chos ston pa'i dran pa/ chos nyid kyi ting nge 'dzin/ ye shes dpag tu med pa'i shes rab/ spang bya thams cad las rnam par grol ba rnams nyams pa mi mnga' ba ni rtogs pa ma 'dres pa drug sku'i cha byad dang spyod lam sogs kyis sems can 'dul ba sku'i 'bras bu+u ldan pa'i chos ston pa/ gsung gi ye shes sems can kun gyi rjes su son pa thugs kyi phrin las rnams ye shes sngon du 'gro zhing*/ ye shes rjes su 'brang ba phrin las ma 'dres pa gsum/ dus gsum gyi chos thams cad ji lta bar mkhyen pas ma chags pa/ ji snyed par mkhyen pas ma thogs par ye shes kyi gzigs pa 'jug pa ni ye shes ma 'dres pa gsum mo//

lnga pa (de bzhin nyid )ni/ sangs rgyas thams cad kyis bshad pa'i myang 'das kyi ngo bo nyid de bzhin nyid do// drug pa (rang 'byung )ni/ de bzhin nyid sngon du gyur pa'i rten 'brel las chos ji snyed pa mkhyen pa'i ye shes rang byung ngo*// bdun pa (sangs rgyas kyi rnam pa )ni/ chos de rnams kyi rnam pa thams cad mngon par rdzogs par sangs rgyas pa'i ngo bo 'ba' zhig las gzhan du snang ba med pa'o// sgom mkhan gang zag gnyis pa sgom mkhan gang zag ni/ sangs rgyas rnams la lhag par byas// de la dge ba'i rtsa ba bskrun// dge ba'i bshes kyi mgon bcas pa// 'di mnyan pa yi snod yin no// sangs rgyas bsten dang kun 'dri dang*// sbyin dang tshul khrims sogs spyod pas// len dang 'dzin pa la sogs pa'i// snod du dam pa rnams bzhed do// sher phyin sgom pa po'i gang zag gang zhe na/ sngon gyi sangs rgyas rnams la lhag par bsnyen bkur byas pa dang*/ sangs rgyas de dag las dge ba'i rtsa ba bskrun pa dang*/ dge ba'i bshes kyis yongs su zin pas mgon dang bcas pa ni sher phyin zab mo 'di nyan pa'i snod yin no/ /sangs rgyas rnams dge ba'i bshes su bsten pa dang de dag la sher phyin gyi don kun 'dri ba dang*/ sbyin dang tshul khrims sogs kyi phar phyin la spyod pas ni/ nyan par ma zad thos nas mi skrag cing dang du len pa dang tshig don 'dzin pa dang la sogs pas sgrub pa dang khong du chud par 'gyur ba'i snod du dam pa rnams bzhed do/ /mdo ni/ yum 'di sems can gang dag gi rna lam du grag par 'gyur ba de dag thams cad kyang de bzhin gshegs pa la dge ba'i rtsa ba bskyed pa'o/ /zhes sogs so// sbyor ba'i ngo bo/ gsum pa sbyor ba'i ngo bo la gnyis te/ rang bzhin gyi sbyor ba lnga/ gnas skabs kyi sbyor ba bco lnga'o/ /dang po ni/ gzugs la sogs la mi gnas phyir// de la sbyor ba bkag pa'i phyir// de yi de bzhin nyid zab phyir//

de rnams gting dpag dka' ba'i phyir// de dag tshad ni med phyir dang*// gzugs dang la sogs pas rnam mkhyen gyi bar la zhen pas mi gnas pa'i phyir dang*/ de la sbyor ba bkag pa'i phyir dang*/ de'i de bzhin nyid zab pa'i phyir dang*/ de'i de bzhin nyid rnams gting dpag dka' ba'i phyir dang*/ de dag gi de bzhin nyid tshad ni med pa'i phyir dang*/ go rim bzhin du gzung ba la zhen pa bkag pa dang 'dzin pa la zhen pa bkag pa dang gzhi lam rnam pa skye med du rtogs pa'i ting nge 'dzin lnga la de dang*/ de'i sgrub byed dang mthun pa'i ming can gyi sbyor ba zhes bya'o/ /'di rnams tshogs lam nas rgyun mtha'i bar du yod pa'o// gnyis pa (gnas skabs kyi sbyor ba bco lnga )ni/ tshegs chen yun ring rtogs pa'i phyir// lung bstan phyir mi ldog nyid dang*// nges 'byung bar chad med bcas dang*// byang chub nye dang myur ba dang*// gzhan don 'phel med 'grib med phyir// chos dang chos min sogs mi mthong*// gzugs sogs bsam mi khyab mi mthong*// gzugs sogs de yi mtshan ma dang*// de yi ngo bor rnam mi rtog/ 'bras bu rin chen sbyin byed dang*// de ni dag pa mtshams dang bcas// yum la skrag pa skye srid pas tshegs chen pos yun ring nas yum rtogs pa'i phyir dang*/ yum la mi skrag pas rdzogs byang du lung bstan thob pa'i phyir dang*/ yum thos nas myur du 'dzin pas phyir mi ldog pa nyid kyi phyir dang*/ yum gyi 'gal zla sa gnyis sogs las nges par 'byung ba'i phyir dang*/ byang chub kyi bar chad mthong spangs rtog pa rags pa med pa dang bcas pa'i phyir dang*/ zag med kyi chos gsar pa thob pas byang chub la nye ba'i phyir dang*/ myur du byang chub par 'gyur ba'i phyir/ rim pas tshogs lam pa dbang rtul dang drod rtse bzod mchog mthong lam sa gnyis pa nas bdun pa'i bar la gnas pa'i byang sems kyi ting nge 'dzin bdun po rnams la de dang de'i sgrub

pa zhes bya'o/ /chos 'khor bskor zhing bskul ba'i gzhan don sgrub pa'i phyir dang*/ chos nyid 'phel ba med 'grib pa med par mthong ba'i phyir dang*/ chos dkar po'i las dang chos min nag po'i las sogs mi mthong ba'i phyir dang*/ gzugs sogs la bsam gyis mi khyab par mi mthong bas mi rlom pa'i phyir dang*/ gzugs sogs de'i mtshan ma dang de'i ngo bor rnam par mi rtog pa'i phyir sa brgyad par gnas pa'i byang sems kyi ting nge 'dzin gyi khyad par lnga la de dang de'i sgrub pa zhes bya'o/ /rgyun zhugs nas rdzogs pa'i sangs rgyas kyi bar gyi 'bras bu rin chen drug gzhan la sbyin par byed pa'i phyir dang*/ gnas ngan len gyi dri ma phra mo de ni dag par byed pa'i phyir dang*/ lo zla'i sa mtshams dang bcas par yum 'bri ba sogs la dam bcas pa las phyir mi nur ba'i phyir sa dgu pa bcu pa'i ting nge 'dzin dang*/ tshogs lam nas sa bdun pa'i bar gyi byang sems kyi bgyi ba la de dang de'i sgrub pa zhes bya'o/ /mdo ni/gzugs la mi gnas pa de'i tshe gzugs la rnal 'byor du byed pa yin no/ /zhes sogs so// yon tan dang skyon bshad pa/

bzhi pa sbyor ba'i sngon 'gro'i chos la bzhi ste/ yon tan/ skyon/ mtshan nyid/ thar pa cha mthun shes pa'o/ /dang po (yon tan shes pa )ni/ bdud kyi mthu bcom la sogs pa// yon tan rnam pa bcu bzhi'o// yum sgom pa la spro ba bskyed pa'i phyir gsungs pa/ bdud kyi mthu bcom la sogs pa'i/ /yon tan rnam pa bcu bzhi'o/ /'di rnams tshogs lam nas thob mod legs par sbyar ba sbyor lam yan du'o/ /mdo ni/ bcom ldan 'das de rnams kyi mthus bdud sdig can gyis bar chad bya bar mi nus so/ /zhes sogs so/ /bcu bzhi ni/ sangs rgyas kyi byin gyis brlabs pas bdud kyi mthu bcom pa gcig sangs rgyas rnams kyi thugs kyis dgongs pa gny-i+is/ sangs rgyas kyi spyan gyis gzigs pa gsum/ rdzogs pa'i byang chub tu nye ba bzhi/ phyir mi ldog tu ma gyur kyi bar du nam yang ngan 'gror mi skye ba lnga/ sangs rgyas rnams dang mi 'bral ba drug phyin drug sogs zag med kyi chos dang mi 'bral ba bdun/ yul lho byang rnams su sangs rgyas par 'gyur zhing de ltar spyod pa la sangs rgyas kun gyis bsngags pa brgyad/ zag med kyi chos yongs su rdzogs par 'gyur ba dgu yum mi spong zhing thos pa'i tshe dga' bde chen po skye ba bcu/ dam bca' brtan pas bdud kyis bsgyur mi nus pa bcu gcig skye bo mang po rdzogs byang la 'god nus pa bcu gnyis/ rnam smin phun tshogs yongs su 'dzin pa bcu gsum/ sems can gyi don rgya chen po nus pa bcu bzhi'o// 'di skabs kyi mdor/ lnga brgya'i tha ma la zhes pa las 'phros nas bstan pa'i gnas tshad bshad na/ skal bzang du gsungs pa ltar/ ston pa 'das nas bstan pa lo lnga stong gnas te/ de yang*/ dgra bcom phyir mi 'ong rgyun zhugs gtso bor thob pa khong du chud pa'i dus la lnga brgya pa gsum/ shes rab ting 'dzin tshul khrims gtso cher sgrub pa'i dus la lnga brgya pa gsum/

mngon pa mdo sde 'dul ba gtso cher ston pa lung gi dus la lnga brgya pa gsum/ lta spyod rnal ma med par rab byung gi rtags tsam 'dzin pa'i dus la lnga brgya pa gcig rnams so/ /ding sang rgyal ba'i dbang po dgung lo zhe gcig bzhes pa'i dus 'di ni/ dus 'khor lugs kyi ston pa 'das nas lo nyis stong bzhi brgya dang nyi shu rtsa lnga song ba ste/ des na ting nge 'dzin gyi lnga brgya'i nang nas lo bzhi brgya dang nyi shu rtsa lnga song zhing bdun cu don lnga lus pa'o// gnyis pa skyon shes pa ni/ skyon ni bcu tshan bzhir bcas pa// drug tu nges par rtogs par bya// yum sgom pa la bar chad du 'gyur ba'i skyon bsal dgos pas gsungs pa/ skyon ni bcu tshan bzhir bcas pa/ /drug tu nges par rtogs par bya/ /zhes zhe drug ste/ tshogs lam nas sa bdun pa'i bar yod cing*/ gtso cher tshogs sbyor na'o/ /mdo sdud par/ 'gro ba'i don ma byas par glog bzhin myur du yang*// yongs su nyams par 'gyur ba 'di ni bdud kyi las// zhes sogs so// zhe drug ni/ spobs pa ha cang 'phyis pa gcig /ha cang myur ba gnyis/ glal ba rgod pa phan tshun brdeg pa gsum/ sems g.yeng ba bzhi/ yi ge gzhan la chags pa lnga/ yum gyi ro ma myong nas stan las langs te 'gro ba drug /glal zhing lung 'bogs pa bdun/ yum rtsa ba 'dra ba bor nas nyan rang gi mdo sde yal ga 'dra ba slob par sems pa brgyad/ rnyed bkur gyi phyir yum bor nas dman pa'i mdo sde la slob pa dgu /yum bor nas dman pa'i mdo sde las rnam mkhyen 'tshol ba bcu/ rgyal phran dang 'khor los bsgyur rgyal bsgrun pa ltar nyan rang gi mdo sde dang yum mnyam par mos nas nyan rang gi mdo sde la slob pa gcig /nor bu rin po che dang nor bu 'ching bu mnyam par sems pa ltar yum rnyed pa bor nas nyan rang gi mdo sde las rnam mkhyen btsal bar sems pa gnyis/ yum la spyod pa'i tshe gzugs nas rnam mkhyen gyi chos la rnam rtog gi spobs pa 'phro ba gsum/

dngos po med pa la yum du zhen pa bzhi/ yi ge la yum du zhen pa lnga/ yi ge med pa la yum du zhen pa drug chos spyod kyi tshe yul gyi bya ba mang po bskyed pa bdun/ grong gi skyes pa bud med dang de dag gi las sna tshogs yid la byed pa brgyad/ rnyed bkur gyi ro myang ba dgu yum bor nas bdud kyis btags pa'i nyan rang gi mdo las thabs mkhas 'tshol ba bcu'o// yum gyi chos spyod la 'chad po brtson la nyan po mi brtson pa gcig /'chad po rnyed bkur 'dod la nyan po mi 'dod pa gnyis/ 'chad po sbyangs yon bcu gnyis dang ldan la nyan po mi ldan pa gsum/ 'chad po bdog pa gtong zhing dge la brtson la dbang po rno la nyan po ser sna le lo can dbang po rtul ba bzhi/ 'chad po gsung rab yan lag bcu gnyis shes la nyan po mi shes pa lnga/ de dag las ldog pa lnga dang bcu'o/ /dpon slob gang rung gcig thabs mkhas ldan la gcig mi ldan pa gcig/ de bzhin du gzungs thob ma thob gnyis/ yum gyi chos spyod la 'dun mi 'dun gsum/ sgrib pa lnga dang bral ma bral bzhi/ 'khor bas 'jigs nas myang 'das da lta nyid du 'dod mi 'dod lnga/ zla med gcig pur brtson mi brtson drug /'chad po nyan po rjes su 'brang ba mi 'dod la nyan po phyi bzhin 'brang ba bdun/ zang zing cung zad kyi phyir chos spyod la brtson mi brtson brgyad/ srog gi bar chad 'ong ba'i phyogs su 'gro mi 'gro dgu /'tsho ba 'phongs pa'i phyogs su 'gro mi 'gro bcu'o// 'chad po 'tsho ba mod phyogs 'gro zhing nyan po rjes su 'brang ba las ldog pa gcig /'chad po 'jigs bcas kyi sar 'gro bar bcos nas nyan po rjes su 'brang ba ldog pa gnyis/ 'chad po bsod snyoms mod pa'i grong la chags pas blta zhing nyan po rjes su 'brang ba ldog pa gsum/ yum las ldog pa'i phyir bdud kyis yum ni nged kyi 'di yin gyi khyod kyis spyod pa de min no zhes dbyen byed pa la the tshom skyes nas yum spong ba bzhi/

de'i mthus yum ltar bcos pa la slob pa lnga/ bdud sdig can dge sbyong gi tshul gyis sems bsgyur nas de la dad par byed pa drug go/ theg chen sbyor ba'i mtshan nyid/ gsum pa mtshan nyid shes par bya ba la gnyis te/ spyi'i don dang*/ gzhung don no/ /dang po la gnyis te/ mtshan nyid spyi'i rnam gzhag /skabs bab bshad pa'o// dang po ni/ mtshan nyid la me'i tsha ba lta bu rang gi mtshan nyid/ mi rtag pa lta bu spyi'i mtshan nyid/ dngos po gcig la'ang log pa la ltos nas ldog pa du ma can ni rnam par dbye ba'i mtshan nyid/ ma khyab khyab ches sogs gcod pa rigs mi mthun sel ba'i mtshan nyid don la med kyang*/ blo ngor dogs pa sel phyir bkod pa log rtog sel ba'i mtshan nyid rnams las 'dir bshad pa ni snga ma'o// gnyis pa (skabs bab bshad pa )ni/ gzhung 'dir rnam par bzhag 'jog mtshan nyid par mi bzung la/ gang bzung na/ mtshan gzhi dang mtshon cha ni don dang skad dod gnyis kar gcig pas don la tha dad med mod/ 'on kyang dper na/ 'tshed pa zhes pa'i sgra gcig nyid/ gang gis 'tshed pa/ gang 'tshed pa zhes/ bya byed gnyis kar drang rung ba bzhin/ mtshan nyid ces pa'i sgra gcig nyid/ gang gis mtshon pa/ gang mtshon pa'i bya byed gnyis kar 'brel ba la dgongs nas gsungs pa'o// des na shes khyad byed gsum ni gang gis mtshon byed byed sgrub bo/ / ngo bo nyid mtshan ni gang mtshon pa las sgrub bo/ /de gnyis ni rtags dang bsgrub bya lta bu shes byed dang shes bya'o// de yang ji ltar mtshon na/ shes mtshan byed mtshan gnyis kyi rim par mkhyen gsum sbyor ba'i steng gi rang don rtogs pa dang gzhan don phrin las bskyed pa'i nus pa de gnyis yod par mtshon pa ste mi ldan rnam gcod do/ /khyad mtshan gyis nyan rang gis sbyor ba la'ang nus pa de gnyis yod dam snyam pa bsal nas 'di kho nar yod pa mtshon pa ste gzhan ldan rnam gcod do/ /gang mtshon pa'i mtshan gzhir ni sbyor ba dang de steng gi nus pa gnyis ka bzung ngo*//

gnyis pa gzhung don la gnyis te/ mdor bstan pa dang*/ rgyas par bshad pa'o/ /dang po ni/ gang gis mtshon de mtshan nyid du// shes bya de yang rnam pa gsum// shes pa khyad par byed pa ste// ngo bo nyid gang mtshon bya yang*// sbyor ba sgom pa la'ang de'i mtshan nyid shes dgos pas gsungs pa/ gang gis mtshon de sbyor ba'i mtshan nyid du shes par bya ba'i mtshon byed kyi mtshan nyid de yang rnam pa gsum ste shes pa khyad par byed pa'i mtshan nyid de/ de gsum gyi sbyor ba'i ngo bo nyid bcu drug gis mkhyen gsum bskyed pa gang mtshon par bya ba'o/ /yang ni snga mar ma zad 'di yang mtshan nyid do zhes pa'o//mtshan nyid kyi sa mtshams ni tshogs lam nas rgyun mtha'i bar du'o// gnyis pa (rgyas par bshad pa )la bzhi ste/ rtogs pa mthar thug bskyed nus par ston pa shes pa/ nus pa phun tshogs de nyan rang la med par ston pa khyad par/ gzhan don rgya chen sgrub nus par ston pa byed pa/ khyad chos de rnams dang ldan pa'i sbyor ba ngo bo nyid mtshan no/ /dang po (rtogs pa mthar thug bskyed nus par ston pa shes pa )la gsum ste/ gzhi shes/ lam shes/ rnam mkhyen gyi shes mtshan no/ /dang po ni/ de bzhin gshegs pa 'byung ba dang*// 'jig rten 'jig med bdag nyid dang*// sems can sems kyi spyod pa dang*// de bsdus pa dang phyir ltas dang*// mi zad pa yi rnam pa dang*// chags bcas sogs dang rgya chen dang*// chen por gyur dang tshad med dang*// rnam shes bstan du med pa dang*// sems bltar med dang shes pa dang*// g.yo ba la sogs zhes bya dang*// de las gzhan yang de dag ni// de bzhin nyid kyi rnam par shes// thub pas de bzhin nyid rtogs de// gzhan la bstan pa zhes bya ba// thams cad shes pa nyid skabs kyi// shes pa'i mtshan nyid bsdus pa yin// dang po yum las de bzhin gshegs pa 'byung ba dang*/ gnyis pa phung lnga'i 'jig rten de kho nar rgyun dang skad cig gi 'jig pa med pa'i bdag nyid dang*/

gsum pa sems can rnams kyi sems kyi spyod pa tshad med pa dang*/ bzhi pa sems de nang du bsdus pa dang*/ lnga pa sems de phyir bltas pas rnam par g.yengs pa dang*/ drug pa bral ba'i 'dus ma byas su gyur pa sems de mi zad pa'i rnam pa dang*/ bdun pa sems nyon mongs chags pa sogs dang bcas pa dang*/ sogs pas brgyad pa chags sogs dang bral ba dang*/ dgu pa chos nyid kyi ngo bo nyid yin pas sems rgya chen po dang*/ bcu pa thams cad la khyab pas sems chen por gyur pa dang*/ bcu gcig pa rten med pas sems tshad med pa dang*/ bcu gnyis pa rang gi mtshan nyid med pas rnam shes 'di'o zhes bstan du med pa dang*/ bcu gsum pa sems de bzhin gshegs pa'i spyan gyis kyang bltar med pa dang*/ bcu bzhi pa shes pa de g.yo ba ste yul la sgrub pa'i sgo nas 'jug pa dang la sogs pas 'du ba ste dgag pa'i sgo nas 'jug pa'o// de yang*/ bdag dang 'jig rten rtag pa dang mi rtag pa dang gnyis ka dang gnyis min du 'dod pa sngon mthar brten pa/ bdag dang 'jig rten mtha' ldan dang mi ldan pa dang gnyis ka dang gnyis min du 'dod pa phyi mthar brten pa/ sangs rgyas grongs nas 'byung ba dang mi 'byung ba dang gnyis ka dang gnyis min du 'dod pa myang 'das la brten pa/ lus srog gcig dang tha dad du 'dod pa lus srog la brten pa'o/ /de las rtag pa dang mtha' mi ldan pa dang grongs nas 'byung ba ni g.yo ba ste rtag lta'o/ /de las ldog pa rnams ni 'du ba ste chad lta'o/ /gnyis ka rnams ni gcer bu pa'i lta ba bkram pa ste sgrub pa'o/ /gnyis min rnams ni gnas ma bu pa'i lta ba bcums pa ste dgag pa'o/ /lus srog gcig tu lta ba bye brag pa dang tha dad du lta ba grangs can te snga ma sgrub pa phyi ma dgag pa'o/ /'di dag ni 'dzam gling du chos 'khor bskor ba'i tshe phyi rol pa rnams kyi lta ba drug cu rtsa gnyis kyi don mtha' bcu bzhir bcad nas zhus pa ste thams cad kyang bdag las brtsams pa yin pas khyad gzhi med pa la khyad chos mi 'thad la/

khyad gzhi bkag na don du mi 'gyur bar dgongs nas lan lung du ma bstan pa'o// des na gang zag so sor sbyar ba ni/ rnam pa gsal phyir tsam ste thams cad kyang phyi rol pa'i lta ba yin la de rnams yul med sgyu ma lta bu'o zhes bya ba dang*/ bco lnga pa de las gzhan du yang phung po lnga po de dag ni de bzhin nyid kyi rnam par shes pa dang*/ bcu drug pa thub pas chos rnams kyi de bzhin nyid rtogs sh-ing de gzhan la ston par byed pa zhes bya ba 'di rnams kyis dben pa sogs thams cad shes pa nyid kyi sbyor ba'i skabs kyi shes pa'i mtshan nyid bsdus pa de sbyor ba de la yul 'di rnams shes pa'i nus pa yod pa yin no/ /mdo ni/ yum zab mo 'di ni de bzhin gshegs pa bskyed pa'o/ /zhes sogs so// gnyis pa (lam shes kyi shes mtshan )ni/ stong nyid mtshan ma med bcas dang*// smon pa rnam par spangs pa dang*// skye med 'gag pa med sogs dang*// chos nyid rnam par 'khrug med dang*// 'du mi byed dang rnam mi rtog/ rab dbye mtshan nyid med nyid la// lam shes nyid kyi skabs kyis ni// shes pa'i mtshan nyid yin par bzhed// dang po yum spros pas stong pa nyid dang*/ gnyis pa rgyu'i mtshan ma med pa dang bcas pa dang*/ gsum pa 'bras bu la smon pa rnam par spang pa dang*/ bzhi pa gsar du skye ba med pa dang*/ lnga pa sngar yod 'gag pa med pa dang*/ sogs pas kun nas nyon mongs pa dang dad sogs rnam byang dang spang bya'i dngos po dang myang 'das kyi ngo bo nyid dang chos dbyings kyi rten dang 'gyur ba'i chos su med pa drug dang*/ bcu gnyis pa chos nyid lha mi'i sgro skur gyi rnam par 'khrug tu med pa dang*/ bcu gsum pa rgyus 'du mi byed pa dang*/ bcu bzhi pa de'i phyir gang du yang rnam par mi rtog pa dang*/ bco lnga pa stong nyid sogs mtshan nyid kyi rab dbye dang*/ bcu drug pa mtshan nyid rnams don dam du med pa nyid la gsal snang thob pa 'di rnams kyis bya dka' ba sogs lam shes nyid kyi sbyor ba'i skabs kyi ni shes pa'i mtshan nyid yin par bzhed do/

/mdo ni/ yum ni stong pa nyid ky-i mtshan nyid do/ /zhes sogs so// gsum pa (rnam mkhyen gyi shes mtshan )ni/ de ni nyid kyi chos brten nas// gnas dang gus par bya ba dang*// bla ma nyid dang mnyes pa dang*// de la mchod dang byed med dang*// kun tu 'jug mkhyen gang yin dang*// ma mthong ston par mdzad pa dang*// 'jig rten stong nyid rnam pa dang*// brjod dang shes mdzad mngon sum mdzad// bsam mi khyab dang zhi nyid ston// 'jig rten 'du shes 'gog pa la// rnam pa kun mkhyen tshul la ni// shes pa'i mtshan nyid ces bshad do// dang po dus gsum gyi sangs rgyas de rnams ni rang nyid kyis rtogs pa'i chos yum la brten nas gnas pa dang*/ gnyis pa gus par bya ba dang*/ gsum pa bla ma nyid du bya ba dang*/ bzhi pa mnyes par bya ba dang*/ lnga pa de la mchod pa'i yul du ston pa dang*/ drug pa de dag kyang don dam du bya ba med pa dang*/ bdun pa shes bya kun tu ye shes 'jug pas mkhyen pa gang yin pa dang*/ brgyad pa mtshan ma'i sgo nas gang du yang ma mthong ba de de kho na nyid du ston par mdzad pa dang*/ dgu pa kun rdzob kyi 'jig rten stong nyid kyi rnam par

dang*/ bcu pa de yang thog mar thos pa'i ngor stong nyid du brjod pa dang*/ bcu gcig pa bsam pa'i ngor de shes par mdzad pa dang*/ bcu gnyis pa sgom pa'i ngor de mngon sum du mthong bar mdzad pa dang*/ bcu gsum pa med pa kho na min pa bsam gyis mi khyab par ston pa dang*/ bcu bzhi pa spros pa zhi ba nyid du ston pa dang*/ bco lnga pa 'jig rten kun rdzob kyi gzung ba 'gog pa dang*/ bcu drug pa kun rdzob pa'i 'du shes 'dzin pa 'gog pa la gsal snang thob pa 'di rnams kyis dmigs pa'i ngo bo nyid sogs rnam pa kun mkhyen gyi sbyor ba'i tshul la ni yod pa'i shes pa'i mtshan nyid ces bshad do/ /mdo ni/ de bzhin gshegs pa rnams yum 'di la brten cing gnas so/ /zhes sogs so// gnyis pa nus pa phun tshogs de nyan rang la med par ston pa khyad mtshan la gnyis/ mdor bstan pa dang*/ rgyas par bshad pa'o// dang po ni/ bsam mi khyab sogs khyad par gyis// khyad zhugs bden pa'i spyod yul can// skad cig ma ni bcu drug gis// khyad par mtshan nyid bshad pa yin// zhes pas/ dngos su mthong lam khyad 'phags par bstan pas sgom lam dang mi slob lam yang khyad zhugs pa go nus so// gnyis pa (rgyas par bshad pa )ni/ bsam mi khyab dang mi mnyam dang*// gzhal dang bgrang las yang dag 'das// 'phags pa kun sdud mkhas pa yis// rig bya thun mong min shes nyid// shes myur bri dang gang med dang*// sgrub dang yang dag 'grub pa dang*// dmigs pa rten dang bcas pa dang*// mtha' dag pa dang yongs 'dzin dang*// ro myang med dang khyad par ni// bcu drug bdag nyid shes bya ste// gang gi lam ni gzhan dag las// khyad du 'phags pas khyad par lam// bden bzhir dmigs pa bzhi bzhi ste khyad par bcu drug go /de la dang po shes rab tshad med pa'i mthus bsam gyis mi khyab pa dang*/ mi mnyam pa dang blos gzhal ba las 'das pa dang grangs kyis bgrang ba las yang dag par 'das pa rtogs pa dang bzhi/

gnyis pa 'phags pa kun gyis yon tan sdud pa dang ji lta ji snyed kyi don la mkhas pa yis rig par bya ba dang nyan rang dang*/ thun mong min pa'i shes rab nyid dang mngon shes nyan rang las myur ba thob pa ste bzhi/ gsum pa bri ba skur 'debs dang gang ba sgro 'dogs med pa dang 'khor gsum dag pas yum sgrub pa dang tshogs gnyis yang dag par 'grub pa dang*/ chos kun la mi rtog par dmigs pa dang bzhi/ bzhi pa lam gyi rten rigs mchog dang bcas pa dang*/ lam gyi yan lag mtha' dag tshang ba dang yongs 'dzin thabs mkhas pas zin pa dang spangs rtogs la ro myang med pa dang bzhi'o// des na khyad par ni/ bcu drug bdag nyid shes bya ste/ /gang gi lam ni gzhan dag las/ /khyad du 'phags pas khyad par lam/ /zhes pa ste chos kyi bdag med ma lus par rtogs pas so/ /mdo ni/ gzugs bsam gyis mi khyab pa dang zhes sogs so// gsum pa gzhan don rgya chen sgrub nus par ston pa'i byed pa'i mtshan nyid ni/ phan dang bde dang skyob pa dang*// mi rnams kyi ni skyabs dag dang*// gnas dang dpung gnyen gling dang ni// yongs 'dren pa zhes bya ba dang*// lhun gyis grub dang theg gsum gyi// 'bras bu mngon sum mi byed bdag/ tha ma rten gyi mdzad pa ste// 'di ni byed pa'i mtshan nyid yin// skye dgu rnams la tshe phyi ma phan pa dang tshe 'dir bde ba dang gtan du sdug bsngal las skyob pa gsum ni kun shes kyi sbyor ba'i 'o/ /dang po lhag med la 'god pas mi sogs 'gro ba rnams kyi ni skyabs dag dang*/ gnyis pa bden 'dzin bzlog pa gnas dang*/ gsum pa srid zhi mnyam nyid du rtogs par byed pa dpung gnyen dang*/ bzhi pa rang gzhan gyi don sgrub pa gtan gyi don gling dang ni/ lnga pa rang don la sred pa bral bas 'gro ba yongs su 'dren pa zhes bya ba dang*/ drug pa don gnyis 'bad med lhun gyis grub pa dang*/ bdun pa theg pa gsum gyi lam gyis nges par 'byung ba thob kyang*/

yang dag mtha'i 'bras bu mngon sum du mi byed pa'i bdag nyid dag rnams ni lam shes kyi sbyor ba'i 'o// byed pa tha ma ni chos 'khor bskor ba sogs 'gro ba'i rten du gyur pa'i mdzad pa ste rnam mkhyen sbyor ba'i 'o/ /de ltar bcu gcig po 'di ni byed pa'i mtshan nyid yin no/ /mdo ni/ byang chen rnams 'jig rten gyi phan pa dang*/ zhes sogs so// bzhi pa khyad chos de rnams dang ldan pa'i sbyor ba ngo bo nyid mtshan la gsum ste/ kun shes kyi sbyor ba bzhi/ lam shes kyi lnga/ rnam mkhyen gyi bdun no/ /dang po ni/ nyon mongs rtags dang mtshan ma dang*// mi mthun phyogs dang gnyen po dag/ dben dang chags sogs nyon mongs dang*/ de'i rtags lus ngag gi tshul min dang*/ de'i mtshan ma tshul min yid byed dang*/ mi mthun phyogs srid pa dang gnyen po myang 'das la rtog pa'i shes sgrib dag gis dben pa'o// gnyis pa (lam shes kyi lnga )ni/ dka' dang nges pa dang*// ched du bya dang mi dmigs dang*// mngon par zhen pa bkag pa dang*// gzod nas med pa'i sems can sgrol bas spyod pa bya dka' bas dben pa dang*/ thams cad chos dbyings ro gcig tu rtogs pas nges pa'i lta ba dang*/ chen po gsum gyi ched du bya ba dang*/ 'khor gsum mi dmigs pa dang*/ yum la'ang mngon par zhen pa bkag pa dang ngo*// gsum pa (rnam mkhyen gyi bdun )ni/ dmigs pa zhes bya gang yin dang*// mi mthun thogs pa med dang de// gzhi med 'gro med skye med dang*// de bzhin nyid ni mi dmigs dang*// ngo bo nyid bcu drug bdag nyid// mtshon bya lta bur mtshon pas na// mtshan nyid bzhi par bzhed pa yin// rnam pa thams cad la dmigs pa zhes bya ba gang yin pa dang*/ de yang 'khrul pa'i snang ba dang mi mthun pa don dam nyid dang*/ shes bya kun la thogs pa med par 'jug pa dang*/ de bzhin nyid la 'khrul pa'i gzhi'am gnas med pa dang*/ 'gro 'ong med pa dang*/

skye 'gag med pa dang*/ de bzhin nyid ni de las gzhan du mi dmigs pa dang*/ de ltar sbyor ba'i ngo bo nyid yul can ye shes spros pas dben pa'i cha bcu drug gi bdag nyid de snga ma gsum gyis 'di mtshon par bya ba'i gzhi lta bur mtshon pas na mtshan nyid bzhi par bzhed pa yin no/ /lta bur zhes pa tha snyad tsam du yin pa'i don no/ /mdo ni/ 'dod chags rnam par bsal bas dben pa'i rang bzhin du 'gyur ro/ /zhes sogs so// thar pa cha mthun/ bzhi pa thar pa cha mthun shes pa la gnyis te/ ngo bo/ dbye ba'o/ /dang po ni/ mtshan med rab tu sbyin la sogs// yang dag sgrub la mkhas pa ni// rnam pa thams cad rtogs 'di la// thar pa'i cha dang mthun par 'dod// spyir bsod nams cha mthun dang thar pa cha mthun gnyis las snga ma ni lam ma zhugs kyi dge ba'o/ /phyi ma ni sdug bsngal las thar ba/ de'i phyogs su gzhol ba'i cha/ mi 'gyur bas mthun pa ste thos bsam las byung ba gtso che zhing sgom byung yang yod la/ lus rten za ma ma ning mtshams med can ma yin pa'i gling gsum gyi mi dang 'dod lha dang sems rten bsam gtan gang rung la skye ba'o/ /'dir bye brag tu chos kun mtshan ma med par mos pas bdog pa thams cad rab tu sbyin pa la sogs pa'i thabs kyi cha yang dag par sgrub pa la brtson zhing mkhas pa ni rnam pa thams cad rtogs pa'i phyir bsdus te bsgom pa'i sbyor ba 'di la sngon du 'gro ba'i thar pa'i cha dang mthun par 'dod do/ /mdo ni/ thog mar sems bskyed nas nye bar bzung nas rnam mkhyen gyi sems dang ma bral bar sbyin pa gtong ba dang*/ zhes sogs so// gnyis pa (dbye ba )la gnyis te/ yul gyi dbye ba/ dbang po'i dbye'o/ /dang po ni/ sangs rgyas sogs dmigs dad pa dang*// sbyin sogs spyod yul brtson 'grus dang*// bsam pa phun tshogs dran pa dang*// rnam par mi rtog ting 'dzin dang*// chos rnams rnam pa thams cad du//

shes pa'i shes rab dang rnam lnga// yul sangs rgyas la sogs pa dkon mchog gsum la dmigs pa'i dad pa dang*/ sbyin sogs phar phyin rnams la spyod pa'i yul can brtson 'grus dang*/ sems bskyed sogs bsam pa phun tshogs la dmigs pa'i dran pa dang*/ g.yeng ba la rnam par mi rtog pa'i ting nge 'dzin dang*/ chos rnams kyi rnam pa thams cad rab tu shes par nus pa'i shes rab dang ste sgom byung du ma nges pas dbang po ma yin pa rnam pa lnga'o// gnyis pa (dbang po'i dbye ba )ni/ rdzogs pa'i byang chub rnon po yis// rtogs sla rtul pos rtogs dka' bzhed// rdzogs pa'i byang chub ni dbang po rnon po yis te theg chen gyi dad sogs kyis rtogs sla la dbang po rtul po nyan rang gi dad sogs kyis ni rdzogs byang rtogs dka' bar bzhed do/ /mdo ni/ sangs rgyas rnams yid la sems te mtshan mar mi byed do/ /zhes sogs so// nges 'byed cha mthun/ gnyis pa rnam rdzogs sbyor ba nyid bstan pa la gsum ste/ de skyes pa'i gnas skabs/ rten phyir mi ldog pa'i gang zag /bsgom bya sbyor ba'i ngo bo'o/ /dang po (de skyes pa'i gnas skabs )la gnyis te/ dngos/ zhar byung ngo*/ dang po ni/ dro ba rnams kyi dmigs pa 'dir// sems can thams cad yin par bsngags// de dag nyid la sems mnyam sogs// rnam pa dag ni bcur bshad do// bdag nyid sdig pa las ldog cing*// sbyin la sogs la gnas pas gzhan// de dag la ni 'god pa dang*// bsngags pa brjod dang mthun pa nyid// rtser gyur de bzhin bzod pa ni// rang gzhan brten can bden shes pa// chos mchog de bzhin sems can rnams// smin byed sogs kyis shes par bya// mkhyen gsum thos bsam gyis rtogs nas de dang rjes su mthun pa'i rnam pa bsdus nas bsgoms pa na sbyor lam 'byung zhing de'i rjes thob kyis cha bstan pa/ dro ba rnams kyis dmigs pa 'dir/ sems can thams cad yin par bsngags/

/zhes spyir bstan nas/ de yang sems can de dag nyid la byang chub kyi sems rang gzhan mnyam pa nyid du dmigs pa dang*/ sogs pas byams pa dang*/ snying rje dang*/ nga rgyal dang*/ g.yo med pa phan pa'i sems dang*/ khong khro med cing mi 'tshe ba'i sems dang*/ pha ma dang*/ phu nu dang*/ grogs po dang*/ gnyen dang*/ rus gcig pa'i sems kyis dmigs pa ste drod kyi rnam pa dag ni bcur bshad do/ /bdag nyid sdig pa las zlog cing sbyin pa la sogs phar phyin la gnas pas sems can gzhan yang de dag la ni 'god pa dang*/ de ltar sgrub pa la bsngags pa brjod pa dang*/ de sgrub pa rnams dang sems mthun pa nyid rnams ni rtse mor gyur pa'i 'o/ /rtse mor gnyis don la brtson pa de bzhin du bzod pa'i tshe ni rang gzhan gnyis kar brten pa can te rang gi bden bzhir dmigs pa bzhin gzhan yang de shes pa la 'god pa dang*/ 'bras bu bzhi dang skyon med pa'i theg chen gyi shes pa bskyed pa'i rang bzhin can no/ /chos mchog kyang snga ma de dag bzhin du rang gis sems can rnams smin par byed pa dang*/ sogs kyi sgras sangs rgyas kyi zhing dag pa/ mngon shes dang rnam mkhyen gyi ye shes bskyed pa/ chos phun sum tshogs pa/ dam chos gnas pa 'dzin pa/ gzhan yang de la sbyor zhing der gnas pa la legs pa brjod pa sogs yin par shes par bya'o/ /mdo ni/ sems can rnams kyi drung du sems mnyam pa nyid du gnas par bya'o/ /zhes sogs so// gnyis pa (zhar byung )ni/ 'dir skabs dang po drug tu sbyor mthong sgom pa'i lam ci rigs par gsungs pa ni zlos par mi 'gyur te/ dang po gsum du ni gzhi lam rnam pa gsum skye med kyi lta ba'i cha nas dang*/ phyi ma gsum ni dbang thob phyir dang thob nas dang brtan pa thob phyir sgom pa spyod pa phyin drug gi cha nas bzhag pa'o/ /yang na zlos pa la/ sgra zlos/ don zlos/ skyon can/ skyon med bzhi las/

'di ni skyon med de/ gdul bya gzhan dang gzhan la brten nas gsungs pa'i phyir/ phyogs kyis glang pos kyang*/ slar yang don gzhan la brten nas/ don dam nyid ni bzlas pa yin/ /zhes pa lta bu'o// phyir mi ldog pa'i gang zag bshad pa/ gnyis pa rten phyir mi ldog pa'i gang zag bshad pa la gnyis/ mdor bstan pa dang*/ rgyas par bshad pa'o/ /dang po ni/ byang sems kyi sbyor lam thob pa nyid nas rdzogs pa'i byang chub thob par byed pa las phyir mi ldog par 'gyur zhing de'i phyir gsungs pa/ nges 'byed yan lag nas bzung ste// mthong dang goms pa'i lam dag la// byang chub sems dpa' gang dag gnas// de 'dir phyir mi ldog pa'i tshogs// zhes pa ste/ 'di dag la tshul gsum tshad mas nges pa sogs rtog ge'i rtags kyis rnam gzhag byar med cing*/ mthar thug 'tshang rgya ba'i rgyu tshogs yod pa tsam gyis bzhag pa'ang min la/ des na 'dir bstan gyi rtags de rnams rjes thob tu mthong ba las gang zag de'i rgyud la rdzogs byang gi rgyu bar ma chad du yod par dpog pa'am/ lung la brten nas nges pa bskyed pa yin no// gnyis pa (rgyas par bshad pa )la gsum ste/ sbyor lam pa phyir mi ldog pa'i rtags/ mthong lam pa phyir mi ldog pa'i rtagasapa/ mthong sgom pa phyir mi ldog pa'i rtags so/ /dang po (sbyor lam pa phyir mi ldog pa'i rtags )la gnyis te/ mdor bstan pa dang*/ rgyas par bshad pa'o/ /dang po ni/ gzugs la sogs las ldog sogs rtags// rnam pa nyi shur brjod pa yis// nges 'byed yan lag la gnas pa'i// phyir mi ldog pa'i mtshan nyid 'di/ /zhes pa'o// gnyis pa (rgyas par bshad pa )ni/ gzugs la sogs las ldog pa dang*// the tshom mi dal zad pa dang*// bdag nyid dge ba la gnas shing*// gzhan dag de la 'god pa dang*// gzhan gyi rten can sbyin sogs dang*// zab mo'i don la'ang som nyi med// byams lus sogs dang sgrib pa ni// rnam pa lnga dang mi 'grogs dang*//

bag la nyal kun 'joms pa dang*// dran pa dang ni shes bzhin dang*// gos la sogs pa gtsang ba dang*// lus la srin bu rnams mi 'byung*// gya gyu med sems sbyangs pa dang*// len dang ser sna med sogs dang*// chos nyid ldan par 'gro nyid dang*// sems can don du dmyal tshol dang*// gzhan gyis dkri bar mi btub dang*// lam gzhan nye bar ston bdud la// bdud ces bya bar rtogs pa dang*// sangs rgyas dgyes pa'i spyod pa ste// rtags ni nyi shu de dag gis// drod dang rtse mo bzod bcas dang*// chos mchog rnams la gnas pa ni// rdzogs pa'i byang chub las mi ldog/ dang po gzugs la sogs la dngos por zhen pa las ldog par byed pa dang*/ gnyis pa lta ba ngan pa la bzang po yin nam snyam pa'i the tshom zad pa dang*/ gsum pa ngan song gsum/ kla klo/ 'bras bu che ba'i lha'i nang nas 'du shes med pa pa lha tshe ring po/ rgyu 'bras khyad gsod pa'i log lta can/ sangs rgyas kyi gsung dang 'khor rnam bzhis stong pa/ don mi go ba lkugs pa ste mi dal ba brgyad du skye ba zad pa dang*/ bzhi pa bdag nyid dge ba bcu la gnas shing gzhan dag de la 'god pa dang*/ lnga pa gzhan don gyi rten can sbyin sogs spyod pa dang*/ drug pa gshis lugs zab mo'i don la'ang som nyi med pa dang*/ bdun pa byams pa dang ldan pa'i lus ngag yid gsum dang sogs pas des skyes pa'i las dang*/ brgyad pa 'dod par 'dun pa dang gnod sems dang gnyid rmugs dang rgod 'gyod dang the tshom ste sgrib pa ni rnam pa lnga dang mi 'grogs pa dang*/ dgu pa lta ba'i bag la nyal kun 'joms pa dang*/ bcu pa spyod lam kun tu dran pa dang ni shes bzhin dang ldan pa dang*/ bcu gcig pa gos la sro ma sogs med pa dang sogs pas nad nyung zhing dri nga ba med pas gtsang ba dang rnams ni drod la gnas pa'-i 'o/ /bcu gnyis pa lus la srin bu'i rigs stong phrag brgyad cu rnams mi 'byung ba dang*/

bcu gsum pa dman sems gyi gya gyu med pa'i sems dang*/ bcu bzhi pa bsod snyoms pa/ stan gcig pa/ phyis mi len pa ste zas kyi gsum/ phyag dar khrod pa/ phying pa pa/ chos gos gsum pa ste gos kyi gsum/ dgon pa pa/ bla gab med pa/ shing drung pa/ dur khrod pa ste gnas kyi bzhi/ tsog pu pa/ gzhi ji bzhin pa ste spyod lam gyi gnyis/ de ltar sbyangs pa'i yon tan bcu gnyis len pa dang*/ bco lnga pa ser sna med pa dang sogs pas phyin drug mi mthun phyogs bral ba dang*/ bcu drug pa chos nyid kyi yum dang ldan par 'gro ba nyid dang*/ bcu bdun pa sems can gyi don du dmyal ba tshol ba dang ste der skyes kyang bag tsha med pa rnams ni rtse mor ro/ /bco brgyad pa dge bshes las gzhan bdud sprul sogs kyi log par bkri bar mi btub pa dang*/ bcu dgu pa byang lam las gzhan dman lam nye bar ston pa'i bdud la bdud ces bya bar rtogs pa dang gnyis ni bzod par ro/ /nyi shu pa sangs rgyas dgyes pa'i spyod pa 'khor gsum mi dmigs pas phar phyin spyod pa ste/ rtags ni nyi shu de dag gis/ /drod dang rtse mo bzod bcas dang*/ /chos mchog rnams la gnas pa

ni/ /rdzogs pa'i byang chub las mi ldog /mdo ni/ gzugs las phyir mi ldog pa'i byang sems phyir mi ldog par rig par bya'o/ /zhes sogs so// gnyis pa mthong lam pa phyir mi ldog pa'i rtags la gnyis te/ mdor bstan pa dang*/ rgyas par bshad pa'o/ /dang po ni/ mthong ba'i lam la bzod pa dang*// shes pa'i skad cig bcu drug ni// byang chub sems dpa' mi ldog pa'i// mtshan nyid yin par shes par bya// zhes so// gnyis pa (rgyas par bshad pa )la bden bzhir dmigs pa'i bzhi las/ dang po (sdug bden la dmigs pa )ni/ gzugs sogs 'du shes ldog pa dang*// sems brtan theg pa dman dag las// rnam log bsam gtan la sogs pa'i// yan lag yongs su zad pa dang*// gzugs sogs la mtshan ma'i 'du shes ldog pa dang*/ byang chub kyi sems brtan pa dang*/ theg pa dman pa'i yid byed dag las rnam par log pa dang*/ bsam gtan la sogs pa'i snyoms 'jug thob kyang de dag tu rang dbang med par skye ba'i yan lag yongs su zad pa dang bzhi'o// gnyis pa (kun ldan la dmigs pa )ni/ lus sems yang ba nyid dang ni// 'dod pa spyod la thabs mkhas dang*// rtag tu tshangs par spyod nyid dang*// 'tsho ba rnam par dag nyid dang*// kun nyon bral bas lus sems ldang ba yang ba nyid dang ni/ 'dod pa'i yon tan la spyod pa'i gnas skabs la yang sbyin sogs thabs mkhas pas zin pa dang*/ rang nyid 'dod yon la ro myang med par rtag tu tshangs par spyod pa nyid dang*/ rin chen phreng bar/ tshul 'chos rnyed dang bkur sti'i phyir// dbang po sdom par byed pa ste// kha bsags rnyed dang bkur sti'i phyir// tshig 'jam par ni smra ba'o// gzhogs slong de ni thob bya'i phyir// gzhan gyi rdzas la bsngags byed pa// thabs kyi 'jal ba rnyed pa'i phyir// mngon sum gzhan la smon byed pa// rnyed pas rnyed pa rnams 'dod pa// sngar thob pa la bsngags pa'o// zhes gsungs pa'i log 'tsho lnga dang dbang sdud lung ston sogs mi byed pas 'tsho ba rnam par dag pas 'tsho ba nyid dang bzhi'o//

gsum pa ('gog bden la dmigs pa )ni/ phung sogs bar chad byed rnams dang*// tshogs dang dbang sogs bcas pa yi// g.yul 'gyed phung sogs khams dang skye mched dang bar chad byed pa rgyal po rkun po la sogs pa rnams kyi gtam dang*/ grong gi tshogs kyi gtam dang*/ kun nyon kyi dbang po dang sogs pas shes pa dang yul gyi gtam dang bcas pa dang*/ dmag gi g.yul 'gyed pa'i gtam la sbyor sogs bkag pa bzhi'o// bzhi pa (lam bden la dmigs pa )ni/ ser sna la sogs la// sbyor dang rjes su sbyor ba yi// gnas pa so sor bkag pa dang*// chos ni rdul tsam mi dmigs nyid// rang gi sa la nges pa nyid// sa gsum la ni gnas pa dang*// chos kyi don du srog gtong ba// de 'dra'i skad cig bcu drug ni// blo ldan mthong ba'i lam gnas kyi// phyir mi ldog pa'i rtags dag yin// sbyin sogs kyi mi mthun phyogs ser sna la sogs kyi gtam la dang por sbyor ba dang rjes su rgyun du sbyor ba'i gnas pa so sor bkag pa ste mi smra ba dang*/ kun rdzob pa'i chos ni don du grub par rdul phran tsam yang mi dmigs pa nyid dang*/ rang gi sa dang po la ni gnas par nges pa nyid dang bar chad med pa rnam grol khyad par lam ste rang sa'i lam gsum la ni gnas pa dang*/ dam chos gnas phyir sogs kyi don du rang gi srog kyang gtong phod pa ste bzhi'o/ /de 'dra'i skad cig bcu drug la gnas pa'i mtshan ma ni/ blo ldan mthong ba'i lam gnas kyi*/ /phyir mi ldog pa'i rtags dag yin/ /mdo ni/ gzugs kyi 'du shes las phyir ldog go /zhes sogs so// 'dir dbang sogs las 'phros nas dbang po bshad na/ dbye ba/ sa gang na yod pa/ spong tshul/ yul lo/ /dang po (dbye ba )la/ rnam byang dang*/ kun nas nyon mongs kyi dbang po gnyis/ dang po ni/ 'jig rten pa'i rnam dag la dbang byed pa dad sogs lnga/ zag med kyi rnam dag la dbang byed pa sbyor lam gyi tshe'i dad sogs lnga ste/

mi shes pa kun shes pa'i dbang po/ 'phags pa slob pa'i de lnga ste/ kun shes pa'i dbang po/ mi slob pa'i de lnga ste/ kun shes ldan pa'i dbang po dang brgyad do// gnyis pa (kun nyon gyi dbang po )ni/ 'bras bu nyer spyod la dbang byed pa bde ba/ sdug bsngal/ yid bde/ yid mi bde/ btang snyoms te tshor ba'i dbang po lnga/ yul la dbang byed pa sgo lnga yid dbang dang drug /lus gnas par dbang byed pa srog gi dbang po/ skye bar dbang byed pa pho mo'i dbang po gnyis dang bcu bzhi'o// gnyis pa (sa gang na yod pa )ni/ 'dod par kun nyon gyi dbang po thams cad yod/ de las gzugs na pho mo sdug bsngal yid mi bde med/ gzugs med na srog yid btang snyoms gsum yod pa'o/ /dbang rten ni/ 'dod par rdul rdzas brgyad ka yod/ gzugs na dri ro ma gtogs pa yod/ gzugs med na srog la brten pa'o// gsum pa (spong tshul )ni/ zag bcas kyi cha rnams te/ yid dbang*/ sems bde/ yid bde/ btang snyoms bzhi la mthong spangs sgom spangs spang bya min pa gsum gsum du yod/ yid mi bde la mthong spangs sgom spangs gnyis yod/ sgo lnga pho mo srog sdug bsngal gyi dbang po rnams sgom spangs kho na yin no/ /dad sogs zag bcas dang theg chen ltar na zag bcas mi shes pa kun shes kyi dbang po yang sgom spangs yin no/ /dbang rten ni brgyad ka sgom spangs so// bzhi pa (yul )ni/ 'dod par yul drug gzugs na dri ro ma gtogs pa/ gzugs med na chos kho na yod pa'o/ /gsum pa sgom lam pa phyir mi ldog pa'i rtags la lnga ste/ spyir lam gyi rang bzhin/ de sgom pa'i tshul/ bye brag sgom lam gyi dbye ba/ gong 'phel du 'gyur ba la rtsod spangs/ rgyu 'bras la rtsod spong ngo*// dang po (spyir lam gyi rang bzhin )ni/ sgom pa'i lam ni zab pa ste// zab mo stong pa nyid la sogs// zab pa de ni sgro 'dogs dang*// skur pa'i mtha' las grol ba nyid//

byang 'phags rnams kyi sgom pa'i lam ni zab pa yin te/ mdor/ byang sems gang la gnas nas sangs rgyas kyi chos thams cad rdzogs par byed pa'i gnas ni zab mo ste/ stong pa nyid dang mtshan ma med pa dang smon pa med pa dang*/ 'du bya ba med pa dang skye ba med pa dang 'dod chags dang bral ba 'gog pa dang myang 'das dang zhi ba dang de bzhin nyid dang yang dag pa'i mtha' dang chos kyi tshig bla dwags so/ /zhes gsungs pa'i glo bur dri ma'i gnas med pa'i zab mo stong pa nyid la sogs pa yin pa'i phyir/ gzhi dang 'bras bu dang theg pa yang 'di yin no/ /zab mo de ni mdor gzugs sogs las kyang bzlog mya ngan las 'das par yang bstan zhes pa'i don/ chos dbyings zab mo de ni dngos po yin par sgro 'dogs pa dang*/ myang 'das min pa'i skur pa'i mtha' las grol ba nyid yin te/ de blo rnam shes kyi yul las 'das pas so// gnyis pa (de sgom pa'i tshul )ni/ nges 'byed yan lag dang mthong ba'i// lam dang sgom pa'i lam nyid la// yang dang yang du sems pa dang*// 'jal dang nges rtog bsgom pa'i lam// de lta'i zab mo byang sems kyi sgom tshul ni/ nges 'byed yan lag dang*/ mthong ba'i lam dang*/ sgom pa'i lam nyid la gnas pa'i rim pas snga ma'i tshe zab mo de yang dang yang du sems pa dang*/ gnyis pa'i tshe rang rig pa'i shes rab kyis mngon sum du 'jal ba dang*/ gsum pa'i tshe de nges par rtogs nas sgom pa'i lam rnams so/ /mdo 'og nas thon/ gsum pa( bye brag sgom lam gyi dbye ba )ni/ de ni rgyun chags yin pa'i phyir// chung dang 'bring dang chen po rnams// chung ngu'i chung sogs dbye ba yis// rnam pas rnam pa dgur bzhed do// grangs med la sogs bstan pa rnams// dam pa'i don du bzod ma yin// kun rdzob tu ni thugs brtse ba'i// rgyu mthun de dag thub pa bzhed// rang bzhin rnam dag chos dbyings mngon sum du rtogs rjes phye na/

rang rig pa'i ye shes de ni gdod nas rgyun chags su yod pa'i rtag pa yin pa'i phyir/ de la sgrib pa'i dri ma cung zad bral ba cher bral ba ches cher bral bas ye shes je gsal du gyur pa'i cha nas dbye ba ste/ chung dang 'bring dang chen po rnams/ /chung ngu'i chung sogs dbye ba yis/ /rnam pas rnam pa dgur bzhed do/ /mdo ni/ zab mo 'di dag yang yang sems pa dang 'jal ba dang rtog par byed na grangs med tshad med dpag tu med pa'i dge ba 'phel/ zhes so// 'di las 'phros pa mdor/ grangs ma mchis pa sogs la bye brag ni ci mchis zhes zhus pa'i lan gyi don ni/ grangs med la sogs bstan pa rnams//ming tsam ste/ dam pa'i don du bzod ma yin/ mdo ni/ chos nyid de dag la don dang yi ges tha dad du bya ba mi dmigs/ zhes so/ /'on kyang kun rdzob tu ni sangs rgyas kyi thugs brtse ba chen po'i rgyu mthun gyi rten 'brel las bsod nams brjod du med pa 'byung ba de dag la dgongs nas gsungs par thub pa bzhed de/ brjod du med pa 'di ni de bzhin gshegs pa'i thugs rje chen po'i rgyu mthun gyi bstan pa'o/ /zhes so// bzhi pa (gong 'phel du 'gyur ba la rtsod spangs )la gnyis te/ dogs pa/ lan no/ /dang po ni/ dngos po brjod du med pa la// nyams pa dang ni 'phel mi rung*// bsgom zhes bya ba'i lam gyis ni// ci zhig nyams shing ci zhig thob// dngos po'i gnas tshul chos dbyings ni brjod du med cing 'dus ma byas pa la nyams pa dang ni 'phel ba mi rung ba'i phyir/ de'i rang bzhin can bsgom bya zhes bya ba'i lam gyi ni spang bya ci zhig nyams shing gnyen po ci zhig thob ste mi thob par thal zhes so/ /mdo ni/ brjod du ma mchis pa'i don la 'phel 'grib med na des sbyin sogs 'phel 'grib med par 'gyur ro/ /zhes so// gnyis pa (lan )ni/ byang chub ji lta de bzhin du// 'di ni 'dod pa'i don sgrub byed//

byang chub de bzhin nyid mtshan nyid// de yang de yi mtshan nyid bzhed// de lta'i skyon med de/ 'bras bu rdzogs pa'i byang chub kyis ji ltar gdul bya'i don sgrub pa de bzhin du/ chos dbyings 'dis kyang ni gdul bya'i mngon rtogs 'phel ba dang spang bya zad pa'i 'dod pa'i don sgrub par byed cing*/ de'i rgyu mtshan ni/ 'bras bu byang chub kyang de bzhin nyid de'i mtshan nyid/ de bzhin nyid kyang byang chub de'i mtshan nyid de de gnyis gcig pa'i phyir de ltar bzhed do/ /mdo ni/ chos thams cad kyi de bzhin nyid ji lta ba de bzhin du bla med rdzogs pa'i byang chub bo/ /zhes so// lnga pa (rgyu 'bras la rtsod spong )la gnyis te/ rtsod pa/ lan no/ /dang po ni/ sems ni snga mas byang chub par// rigs min phyi mas kyang ma yin// 'o na don dam par chos dbyings dang byang chub gcig mod/ kun rdzob tu sangs rgyas kyi rgyu la'ang mi rigs pa mthong ste/ sangs rgyas kyi rgyu sems bskyed kyi ni skad cig snga ma phyi ma dang phyi ma snga ma dang mi 'grogs pas dge ba'i tshogs mi 'byung la de med par 'bras bu mi 'byung ba'i phyir zhes pa'i don/ sems ni snga mas byang chub par/ /rigs min phy-i mas kyang ma yin/ /mdo ni/ sems dang po skyes pa ni slad ma skyes pa dang mi 'grogs/ zhes sogs so// gnyis pa (lan )la gnyis te/ dpes lan 'phang ba/ de las skyes pa'i sgom lam pa'i rtags bshad pa'o/ /dang po ni/ mar me'i dpe yi tshul gyis ni// sems skad cig re re nas byang chub mi bskyed na yang de dag phan tshun ltos pa las kun rdzob tu rten 'byung gi skye ba tsam yod de/ de yang mar me'i skad cig snga phyi re res sdong bu mi sreg kyang gnyis char ltos pa na sdong bu tshig pa mngon sum du rig pa'i dpe 'di'i tshul gyis ni shes par gyis/ mdo gzhung gis thon no// gnyis pa (de las skyes pa'i sgom lam pa'i rtags bshad pa )ni/

zab mo'i chos nyid rnam pa brgyad// skye ba dang ni 'gag pa dang*// de bzhin nyid dang shes bya dang*// shes dang spyod dang gnyis med dang*// thabs mkhas pa la zab pa nyid// don dam pa'i sems bskyed rtogs pa'i de ma thag sgom lam zab mo'i chos nyid rnam pa brgyad rtogs pa 'byung ngo zhes rnam par bzhag nas bye brag tu brgyad yod pa'i dang po/ rten 'brel gyi skye ba dang ni/ gnyis pa don du kun rdzob ma grub pas 'gag pa dang*/ gsum pa shin tu phra ba'i de bzhin nyid dang*/ bzhi pa bden gnyis kyi gnas tshul shes bya dang*/ lnga pa gnas tshul rtogs pa'i ye shes dang*/ drug pa ci la'ang mi spyod pa'i spyod pa dang*/ bdun pa don du rtogs bya rtogs byed gnyis tha dad med pa dang*/ brgyad pa gdod nas sangs rgyas zin pa slar sangs rgyas su ston pa thabs mkhas pa la zab pa nyid de de rnams rtogs pa'o/ /mdo ni/ rten cing 'brel 'byung zab pa de ni ngo mtshar ro/ /zhes sogs so// mnyam nyid sbyor ba/ gsum pa bsgom bya sbyor ba'i ngo bo la gsum ste/ chos sku'i rgyu srid zhi mnyam nyid/ longs sku'i rgyu zhing dag pa/ phrin las kyi rgyu thabs mkhas kyi sbyor ba'o/ /dang po (chos sku'i rgyu srid zhi mnyam nyid )la gnyis/ spyi'i don dang*/ gzhung don no/ /dang po ni/ 'di'i 'khor ba ni 'khrul snang sna tshogs myang 'das ni de'i rang bzhin stong nyid yin la/ mnyam nyid kyi tshul ni/ yul de bzhin nyid gcig la yul can 'khrul pas dmigs na srid pa ma 'khrul bas dmigs na zhi ba 'byung ba yin gyi/ don du yul gyi rang bzhin de gnyis ka ma yin pas gnyis kar mi rtog pa'o/ /de sgom pa'i sbyor ba ni tshogs lam nas yod de 'dir rnam rdzogs sbyor ba gzhan ma bstan pas so/ /rgyud la mngon sum 'char ba sa brgyad pa nas so// gnyis pa gzhung don la gnyis te/ dngos dang*/ klan ka spang ba'o/ / dang po ni/ chos rnams rmi lam 'dra ba'i phyir//

srid dang zhi bar mi rtog pa// yongs su rtogs pa'i chos rnams rmi lam dang 'dra ba'i phyir/ srid pa yod dngos dang zhi ba med dgag gang du yang mi rtog par sgom pa'o/ /mdo ni/ sher phyin nyin par sgom pas rnam par 'phel na rmi lam du sgom pas kyang rnam par 'phel lo/ /de ci'i phyir na/ rmi lam dang nyin par ni rnam par rtog pa med pa'o/ /zhes so// gnyis pa (klan ka spang ba )ni/ las med la sogs klan ka yi// lan ni ji skad bshad par zad// rmi lam gyi las la 'bras bu mi 'byung ba bzhin rtog bcas kyi dge ba la'ang 'bras bu mi 'byung ste/ de gnyis mtshungs pas so snyam na/ las gsog pa dang 'bras bu med pa la sogs pa'i klan ka'i skyon med de/ yongs su rtog pa med na las kyi gnas med pas 'bras bu med la/ sad nas yongs su rtog na rmi lam gyi las la'ang 'bras bu 'byung ngo zhes pa'i lan ni/ mdo las/ ji skad bshad pa der zad cing 'dus pa'i phyir/ mdor dri ba ni rmi lam lta bur gsungs pa de lta na las bsog pa'am 'bri ba med do/ /lan ni/ dmigs pa med par las mi skye ste zhes dang*/ 'on te sad nas rnam par rtog na ni de la bsog pa'am 'bri bar yang 'gyur ro zhes so//

zhing dag sbyor ba/ gnyis pa longs sku'i rgyu zhing dag pa'i sbyor ba ni/ sems can 'jig rten de bzhin du// snod kyi 'jig rten ma dag pa// de la dag pa sgrub pa yis// sangs rgyas zhing ni dag pa nyid// dper na sems can gyi 'jig rten glo bur gyi dri ma rnams de bzhin nyid la 'dre ba med pas de khong du chud pa na dri ma 'ja' yal ba ltar 'gyur ba de bzhin 'khrul ngor snang ba'i snod kyi 'jig rten ma dag pa ngan song sogs de dag la snying rje chen po'i rtain 'brel gyi 'khrul pa bsal nas snod dag pa sngar yod gsal bar byas nas sgrub cing sgom pa yis te/ sangs rgyas kyi zhing go chod po ni dag pa'i sems la snang ba nyid do/ /'di ni longs sku'i zhing nyid gtso bor gzung ngo*/ /mdor/ 'khrul ngor dpes gsungs pa/ sa chen po 'di dag baiḍur+ya sngon po'i rgyu las grub pa zhes sogs so// thabs mkhas kyi sbyor ba/ gsum pa phrin las kyi rgyu thabs mkhas kyi sbyor ba la gnyis te/ rtsa ba shes rab/ de snying rjes zin pas thabs mkhas su 'gyur tshul lo/ / dang po ni/ yul dang sbyor ba can 'di ni// yul sher phyin de bzhin nyid skye 'gag med pa dang yul can rang rig pa'i ye shes gnyis yongs su sbyor ba can srid zhi mnyam nyid du rtogs pa 'di ni zhes ngos bzung ba'o/ /mdo ni/ sangs rgyas kyi chos rnams la ji ltar 'dris par bgyi zhes pa'i lan du/ gzugs sogs chos thams cad stong pa'o/ /zhes sogs so/ /'di sgom tshul ni/ stong nyid bag chags goms pa yis// dngos po'i bag chags spong 'gyur zhing*// ci yang med ces goms pa yis// de yang phyis nas spong bar 'gyur/ /zhes pa lta bu'o// gnyis pa (de snying rjes zin pas thabs mkhas su 'gyur tshul )ni/ dgra rnams las ni 'das pa dang*// mi gnas ji bzhin shugs dang ni// thun mong ma yin mtshan nyid dang*// ma chags pa dang mi dmigs dang*//

mtshan ma smon lam zad pa dang*// de yi rtags dang tshad med pa// thabs la mkhas pa rnam pa bcu// dang por de yang snying rje chen pos zin pas phung po lnga'i bdud/ 'khor bar 'ching byed nyon mongs pa'i bdud/ 'chi bdag gi bdud/ gzhan 'phrul dbang byed kyi bdag po lha'i bu'i bdud bzhi'i dgra rnams las ni 'das pa dang*/ gnyis pa zhi ba'i stong nyid la mi gnas pa dang*/ gsum pa dge ba rnams mda' mkhas pas ji ltar 'dod pa bzhin 'phen pa ltar rdzogs byang du bsngo ba'i shugs dang ni/ bzhi pa sems can yal bar mi 'dor ba nyan rang dang thun mong ma yin pa'i mtshan nyid dang*/ lnga pa sems can dang lhan cig bag bsres kyang de'i dri ma ma chags pa dang*/ drug pa chos thams cad mi dmigs pa'i sgo nas ston pa dang*/ bdun pa mtshan mar lta ba zad par byed pa dang*/ brgyad pa 'bras bu la smon par lta ba'i lam zad par byed pa dang*/ dgu pa thams mkhas dang ldan pa de'i rtags su rgyal bas lung ston pa la mtshan mar mi byed pa dang*/ bcu pa shes bya'i rnam grangs tshad med pa shes pa ste/ re re'i mjug tu thabs la mkhas pa zhes sbyar bas rnam pa bcu'o/ /mdo ni/ bdud bzhi dag dang sa gnyis las kyang rab 'das nas/ /zhes sogs so// shes rab kyi pha rol tu phyin pa'i man ngag gi bstan bcos mngon par rtogs pa'i rgyan gyi tshig le'ur byas pa las skabs bzhi pa'o// // shes rab kyi pha rol tu phyin pa'i man ngag gi bstan bcos mngon par rtogs pa'i rgyan gyi tshig le'ur byas pa las skabs bzhi pa'i 'grel pa'o// //
